snippet.title: El Director - Trailer de la Película
snippet.description:
Han sido ocho años de batalla y muchas censuras hasta sacarla adelante, pero este viernes 20 de noviembre se estrena al fin "El Director", basada en mi libro. 

Os espero en el cine!!! 🎬🍿

SINOPSIS
Tras más de dos décadas cubriendo guerras y conflictos, el corresponsal David Jiménez es nombrado director de uno de los principales diarios del país. Su defensa de un periodismo riguroso choca desde el principio con los intereses ocultos del diario, protegidos por Cardenal, el editor. Pronto, la capacidad de David al frente de la redacción será puesta a prueba.

“El director” es una producción de Beta Fiction Spain, Sábado Time, Cardinal Content e Historias de un Director SL con la participación de HBO Max, RTVE y 3Cat y la financiación de ICAA e ICEC.

snippet.description:
Madrid, siglo XVIII. Julia Ponce, hija del pintor de la corte, llega al palacio real y queda deslumbrada por su ambiente. Allí conoce a Gonzalo, el príncipe heredero, que ha vuelto a España obligado por el rey para casarse. Entre los dos surge un amor imposible y prohibido, rodeado de intrigas, celos y pasión, en una corte llena de ambiciones, engaños y venganzas, donde una sociedad secreta de mujeres conspira por el poder.

"𝘑𝘶𝘴𝘵 𝘢 𝘣𝘪𝘵 𝘰𝘧 𝘩𝘰𝘭𝘪𝘥𝘢𝘺 𝘧𝘶𝘯 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘴𝘰𝘮𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘰𝘭𝘥 𝘚𝘤𝘢𝘯𝘥𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘷𝘪𝘢𝘯 𝘮𝘦𝘭𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘩𝘰𝘭𝘺. 𝘔𝘪𝘤 𝘔𝘪𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘦𝘭𝘪 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘮𝘺𝘴𝘦𝘭𝘧 𝘸𝘳𝘰𝘵𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘴𝘰𝘯𝘨 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘢𝘮𝘦 𝘸𝘢𝘺 𝘸𝘦 𝘸𝘳𝘰𝘵𝘦 ‘𝘊𝘢𝘳𝘳𝘪𝘦’, ‘𝘞𝘢𝘭𝘬 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘌𝘢𝘳𝘵𝘩’ 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘮𝘢𝘯𝘺 𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘴. 𝘜𝘴𝘶𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘺, 𝘢 𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘦 𝘯𝘪𝘨𝘩𝘵 𝘫𝘢𝘮 𝘫𝘶𝘴𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘸𝘰 𝘰𝘧 𝘶𝘴. 𝘠𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘴 𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘦𝘳 𝘢𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘯𝘥 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘩𝘰𝘭𝘪𝘥𝘢𝘺𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘭𝘺𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘴 𝘤𝘢𝘮𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘮𝘦. 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘪𝘮𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘺𝘦𝘢𝘳 𝘸𝘩𝘦𝘯 𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘩𝘶𝘮𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘮𝘰𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘴 𝘴𝘦𝘦𝘮 𝘵𝘰 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘦 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦 𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘪𝘭𝘺 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘧𝘢𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘩𝘦𝘯 𝘸𝘦 𝘳𝘦𝘮𝘦𝘮𝘣𝘦𝘳 𝘭𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘥 𝘰𝘯𝘦𝘴, 𝘸𝘩𝘦𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘪𝘴 𝘢𝘭𝘴𝘰 𝘢 𝘧𝘦𝘦𝘭𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘮𝘢𝘺𝘣𝘦 𝘸𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘯 𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘳𝘵 𝘢𝘯𝘦𝘸.” - 𝐉𝐎𝐄𝐘 𝐓𝐄𝐌𝐏𝐄𝐒𝐓

‘𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐘𝐞𝐚𝐫’ is a  beautifully evocative song that brings together Europe’s unmistakable melodic rock sound with the warmth, nostalgia and bittersweet emotions of the holiday season.

Blending melancholy with an uplifting sense of hope, ‘𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐘𝐞𝐚𝐫’ captures something deeply familiar about Christmas: a time when memories of loved ones come flooding back, emotions feel closer to the surface and, perhaps more than at any other time of year, we find ourselves looking towards new beginnings.

The song began life during one of Europe’s trademark late-night writing sessions, with frontman Joey Tempest and keyboardist Mic Michaeli developing the music together. Years later, the festive lyrics came to Joey, giving the song a new meaning and a distinctly seasonal identity.

The accompanying video was directed by Patric Ullaeus, Europe’s long-time creative collaborator, who once again brings his distinctive visual imagination and experience to the project. Shot in Gothenburg in September 2026, the video captures a wonderfully atmospheric Nordic holiday feel, balancing visual storytelling, humour and emotion.

With its combination of heartfelt songwriting, classic Europe melodies and an unmistakably Scandinavian festive atmosphere, ‘This Time of Year’ offers something a little different for the Christmas season.  It’s a song about remembering, reflecting and finding hope and a reminder that even in the most melancholic moments, there is always room for a little Christmas magic.

Europe’s current studio album Come This Madness marks another chapter in the enduring legacy of one of rock’s most celebrated bands as they  channel tension, truth, and raw energy into a record that feels both deeply personal and globally resonant. Come This Madness is out now on vinyl, CD and digital formats.
